chunks.text:
[Intro - the call]
{instrumental, a bold solo French horn calls the main motif, answered by solo cello}
positive_styles: instrumental
heroic cinematic anime main title anthem
F minor
80 BPM
at 0:00 one deep drum hit and a bold solo French horn call, loud and clear, middle register
the call motif: a short F, a leap up a fifth to a long C, one step up to D-flat, then down by steps B-flat, A-flat, G
the solo cello answers with the same motif an octave lower, then the horn repeats it once more, higher and prouder
soft open fifth in the strings underneath, no percussion after the first hit

chunks.text:
[Groove - the Lows]
{instrumental, the drum groove enters, staccato strings drive}
positive_styles: instrumental
heroic cinematic anime main title anthem
F minor
80 BPM
live ensemble drums in a big wooden hall: deep short kick, fat toms, foot stamps on planks, hand claps
stamps on beats 1 and 3, syncopated claps, the same groove all the way
staccato low strings and harp ostinato in eighth notes grouped 3+3+2
short horn stabs on the offbeats echo the call
one sharp two-finger whistle accent on the last beat
stubborn, alive

chunks.text:
[Theme]
{instrumental, the full melody in unison strings and horns, with a countermelody}
positive_styles: instrumental
heroic cinematic anime main title anthem
F minor
80 BPM
live ensemble drums in a big wooden hall: deep short kick, fat toms, foot stamps on planks, hand claps
stamps on beats 1 and 3, syncopated claps, the same groove all the way
violins, violas and French horns in unison carry the main melody, strong and singing, middle register
the melody: each phrase starts with a short note and leaps up to a long note, the leap wider each time, then falls by steps
a clear countermelody in the cellos and bassoons moves against it in long notes
trombones give short supporting chords
memorable, hummable, proud

chunks.text:
[Rise - the Steps]
{instrumental, brass fanfare answers, building to the climax}
positive_styles: instrumental
heroic cinematic anime main title anthem
F minor
80 BPM
live ensemble drums in a big wooden hall: deep short kick, fat toms, foot stamps on planks, hand claps
stamps on beats 1 and 3, syncopated claps, the same groove all the way
trumpets and horns answer with proud rising fanfare calls
harmony climbs D-flat major, E-flat major, C suspended, C major
snare drum roll and tom fill grow louder every bar
the last half bar is an all-drums fill, then one breath of silence

chunks.text:
[Hook - the anthem]
{instrumental, the climax: full orchestra plays the main melody with an octave leap on the downbeat}
positive_styles: instrumental
heroic cinematic anime main title anthem
F minor
80 BPM
the biggest moment of the piece: everything enters together on the first downbeat with a huge hit
the hook melody: a short C, a leap up a full octave to a long high C, then down by steps B-flat, A-flat, G and A-flat
all French horns, trumpets and trombones in unison with violins, a powerful brass section anthem, played twice
violins double the melody an octave higher for brightness
a running high-string countermelody in eighth notes
live ensemble drums in a big wooden hall: deep short kick, fat toms, foot stamps on planks, hand claps
stamps on beats 1 and 3, syncopated claps, the same groove all the way
big ensemble drums on every downbeat, cymbal crashes
triumphant, heroic, unforgettable

chunks.text:
[Answer - cadence]
{instrumental, the answer phrase, brass and strings, strong cadence}
positive_styles: instrumental
heroic cinematic anime main title anthem
F minor
80 BPM
the answering phrase in full brass and strings rises to a high F and falls home to F
trumpets play a short fanfare countermelody between the phrases
live ensemble drums in a big wooden hall: deep short kick, fat toms, foot stamps on planks, hand claps
stamps on beats 1 and 3, syncopated claps, the same groove all the way
big ensemble drum hits every half bar
strong final cadence in F minor

chunks.text:
[Last hits]
{instrumental, two final tutti hits, then ring out}
positive_styles: instrumental
heroic cinematic anime main title anthem
F minor
80 BPM
two huge tutti chord hits on beat 1 and beat 3 of the first bar, the second is the biggest and the last
after the second hit nothing new plays: the chord rings out and decays naturally to silence
F minor chord, horns on top
